verse.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger by the way you treat them. Rather, bring them up with the discipline and instruction that comes from the Lord.

video.title: Fathers, Do Not Provoke Your Children

reflection: It's easy to default to harshness when correcting our kids, but Paul pairs the warning against provoking them with a call to real discipleship. Discipline without instruction breeds resentment; instruction without discipline breeds drift. A father's job is to hold both together, patiently, day after day.
